name: parsly
description: Parsly — public Claude Code skill system by @olegpars.

plugins.name: parsly
plugins.description: One plugin, seven skills: dreamteam (one-shot multi-agent expert council for hard decisions), digger (autonomous multi-hour deep-research pipeline with confidence-tiered knowledge base), meaning (work out WHAT to say before choosing the form), worldbuilder (serial fictional worlds for short-form video with a world bible and continuity checks), ogre (two-headed orchestration mode where a second model of a different architecture answers every fork blind), conveyor (issue-map auto-execution: the head session executes tickets itself or through subagents, and a model of a different family accepts each result), dr-fanout (fan out deep research to four browser models -- ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok -- via Chrome MCP).
